description: This file contains implementation of functions related to quantization prepacking in PyTorch JIT, including identifying prepack nodes, finding floating point weights, and registering prepacked parameters within a module.

methods.name: isPrepackNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is a prepack node for quantized operations.

methods.name: findFPWeight
methods.description: Finds the floating point weight associated with a prepack node.

methods.name: joinPaths
methods.description: Joins a list of path segments into a single string separated by dots.

methods.name: RegisterPrePackParams
methods.description: Registers prepacked parameters in a module for quantization workflows.
